g.text: Eight completed comparisons · gain labels are percentage points
AIME: 30 problems × 16 samples per arm. Our gain 95% problem-bootstrap intervals: 2.6B [4.79, 13.54]; 1.4B [0.83, 10.83].
HumanEval / MBPP: base-test pass@1. ARC-C / HellaSwag: length-normalized accuracy. Other uncertainty is in the result extracts.
* Looped-Qwen3 uses our independent reconstruction. Protocol differences remain; matching the direction does not mean matching the paper.
